operationalGap.interpretation: The repository contains the deterministic backend contract/runtime for a screenshot-derived structured payload, but no verified live bridge from a ChatGPT-uploaded image to System2 persistence was found. The acceptance workflow is readonly/test-oriented and uses synthetic structured fixtures.

correctionDecision.reason: Canonical docs and UI explicitly disclose the operational gap and do not claim that a real Owner screenshot has been imported or that Actual Position Monitor is verified. Create a correction only if later surfaces promote CODE_TESTED/PENDING into current operational capability without physical image-to-persistence evidence.

independentAuditGuardrails: Do not treat synthetic structured fixture success as proof of image extraction integration.
Do not mark Actual Holdings operational until migration/persistence/readback is physically verified in isolated System2 storage.
Do not infer broker connectivity or order authority from holdings monitoring.
The next physical acceptance must use an Owner-provided screenshot or equivalent explicitly authorized real input and preserve confirmation/fail-closed semantics.
